speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Law (Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai) (for the Minister for Law)
text: This Bill is linked to the Supreme Court of Judicature (Amendment) Bill, which we had debated earlier.

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Law (Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai) (for the Minister for Law)
text: In that debate, I have already explained the amendments proposed in both Bills.

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Law (Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai) (for the Minister for Law)
text: Members have raised their questions and expressed their views on both Bills during the earlier debate, although they are still welcome to do so now if there are any other.

speaker: Mr Speaker
text: Would anyone like to contribute at this stage?

speaker: Mr Speaker
text: Before I proceed to start the electronic voting, may I remind Members that they are to be seated at their designated seats and should only start to vote when the voting buttons on their armrests start to blink.

speaker: Mr Speaker
text: Members are advised to check that their names are registered according to their vote indication when the voting results are shown on the display screens.

speaker: Mr Speaker
text: Before I proceed to declare the results of the vote, are there any Members who wish to claim that his or her vote has not been displayed or displayed incorrectly on the screens?

speaker: Mr Edwin Tong Chun Fai
text: Now, Sir, I beg to move, "That the Bill be now read a Third time."

speaker: Mr Speaker
text: As before, do press your vote button firmly in order to register your vote in the system.

speaker: Mr Speaker
text: Before I proceed to declare the results of the vote, are there any Members who wish to claim that his or her vote has not been displayed or displayed incorrectly on the screens?
